features.name: Reconcile backlog
features.description: Pinned baseline/predecessors, acyclic bounded work graph and audience recorded without resetting active work.
acceptance_tests: Pinned baseline/predecessors, acyclic bounded work graph and audience recorded without resetting active work.
features.implementation: NF-01 planning intake; commit identity resolved by git history for this file

features.name: Optional domain authority
features.description: Absent/declined/incompatible states preserve core use and required checks; no automatic install or NDS scope expansion.
acceptance_tests: Absent/declined/incompatible states preserve core use and required checks; no automatic install or NDS scope expansion.

features.name: Governance manifest schema
features.description: Typed required identity, description, version, entry, capabilities, runtime and state; explicit extension and migration policy.
acceptance_tests: Typed required identity, description, version, entry, capabilities, runtime and state; explicit extension and migration policy.

features.name: Enforce C13 manifest
features.description: All names obey version parity; missing required fields and duplicate capability names fail; subset/containment/payload controls preserved.
acceptance_tests: All names obey version parity; missing required fields and duplicate capability names fail; subset/containment/payload controls preserved.

features.name: Canonical consumer agent template
features.description: Installed-relative routing supports all five task classes, conditional ecosystem scope and canonical stopping policy.
acceptance_tests: Installed-relative routing supports all five task classes, conditional ecosystem scope and canonical stopping policy.

features.name: Control inventory
features.description: Every current emitted control has unique registry/documentation mapping; duplicates and drift fail.
acceptance_tests: Every current emitted control has unique registry/documentation mapping; duplicates and drift fail.

features.name: First-contact repairs
features.description: Correct current module/template/schema/control descriptions and links without requiring README frontmatter.
acceptance_tests: Correct current module/template/schema/control descriptions and links without requiring README frontmatter.

features.name: First-contact link coverage
features.description: Broken README path fails C9; correct README without frontmatter and declared examples pass; full/payload regressions pass.
acceptance_tests: Broken README path fails C9; correct README without frontmatter and declared examples pass; full/payload regressions pass.

features.name: Recommendation catalogue
features.description: Empty catalogue valid; recommended entries require exact identities and qualification, separate from availability and authority.
acceptance_tests: Empty catalogue valid; recommended entries require exact identities and qualification, separate from availability and authority.

features.name: Offline bounded resolver
features.description: Explicit roots/inventory only; disabled has no package reads; tampering, unsupported identities and symlink escapes cannot resolve compatible.
acceptance_tests: Explicit roots/inventory only; disabled has no package reads; tampering, unsupported identities and symlink escapes cannot resolve compatible.

features.name: Specialist routing
features.description: Route README/tutorial/reference work to matching optional specialist; selection preserves task/permission requirements.
acceptance_tests: Route README/tutorial/reference work to matching optional specialist; selection preserves task/permission requirements.

features.name: Evidence admission specification
features.description: Accepted DS bytes/versions map scoped observations, freshness, methods and states without becoming host acceptance.
acceptance_tests: Accepted DS bytes/versions map scoped observations, freshness, methods and states without becoming host acceptance.

features.name: Report importer
features.description: Accepted DS conformance bundle; local parsing rejects invalid/stale/empty scope and unsupported contracts; commands stay data; sanitized errors.
acceptance_tests: Accepted DS conformance bundle; local parsing rejects invalid/stale/empty scope and unsupported contracts; commands stay data; sanitized errors.

features.name: Existing assurance binding
features.description: Capture actual admission through existing route, evaluator and receipts; stale or unassessed execution cannot complete task; no state mutation.
acceptance_tests: Capture actual admission through existing route, evaluator and receipts; stale or unassessed execution cannot complete task; no state mutation.

features.name: Independence matrix
features.description: Core-only/offline, selected/declined/alternative/corrupt/unavailable matrix preserves required checks and binding failures.
acceptance_tests: Core-only/offline, selected/declined/alternative/corrupt/unavailable matrix preserves required checks and binding failures.

features.name: Exact-pair compatibility CI
features.description: Separate explicit exact-pair CI with approved inputs and private raw outputs; mandatory core CI independent.
acceptance_tests: Separate explicit exact-pair CI with approved inputs and private raw outputs; mandatory core CI independent.

features.name: Real documentation pilot
features.description: Predeclared real README/tutorial/small-edit pilot versus baseline with authorized runtime/budget and independent assessment.
acceptance_tests: Predeclared real README/tutorial/small-edit pilot versus baseline with authorized runtime/budget and independent assessment.

features.name: Version-specific qualification
features.description: Exact same DS package bytes and DS-30 evidence bind bounded qualification and revalidation triggers.
acceptance_tests: Exact same DS package bytes and DS-30 evidence bind bounded qualification and revalidation triggers.

features.name: Recommendation guidance
features.description: Prequalified immutable pins and matching guidance remain unreleased until final exact-candidate qualification.
acceptance_tests: Prequalified immutable pins and matching guidance remain unreleased until final exact-candidate qualification.

features.name: Final recommendation release
features.description: Freeze final candidate, rerun exact-pair and pilot, verify payload/rollback, human sign-off then exact tag; adoption separate.
acceptance_tests: Freeze final candidate, rerun exact-pair and pilot, verify payload/rollback, human sign-off then exact tag; adoption separate.

features.name: Publication boundary
features.description: Owner-approved per-item provenance/destination, access route, environment/log retention and trusted attestation boundary.
acceptance_tests: Owner-approved per-item provenance/destination, access route, environment/log retention and trusted attestation boundary.

features.name: Independent corrective release
features.description: Independent major corrective candidate/release with before/after regressions, core-only install and existing release gates.
acceptance_tests: Independent major corrective candidate/release with before/after regressions, core-only install and existing release gates.
